transcript.zh_text: 干得好，道格。

transcript.en_text: Okay. Moving forward. You got it.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。继续前进。你行的。

transcript.en_text: Great. Great job.
transcript.zh_text: 太棒了。干得好。

transcript.en_text: Keep going.
transcript.zh_text: 继续。

transcript.en_text: Good. Breathe.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。呼吸。

transcript.en_text: Excellent. Good.
transcript.zh_text: 棒极了。很好。

transcript.en_text: One more.
transcript.zh_text: 再来一次。

transcript.en_text: Great job.
transcript.zh_text: 干得好。

transcript.en_text: One more time. It's almost done. Ready?
transcript.zh_text: 再来一次。快完成了。准备好了吗？

transcript.en_text: Keep breathing.
transcript.zh_text: 继续呼吸。

transcript.en_text: Just his voice. He said, "Get out of the car."
transcript.zh_text: 只有他的声音。他说：“下车。”

transcript.en_text: Anything you can say about the voice?
transcript.zh_text: 关于这个声音你有什么可以说吗？

transcript.en_text: Was it, uh... Accent? Lisp? High? Low?
transcript.zh_text: 是……口音？大舌头？高音？低音？

transcript.en_text: Deep.
transcript.zh_text: 低沉的。

transcript.en_text: That's all I remember.
transcript.zh_text: 我就记得这些了。

transcript.en_text: Then I laid on the horn. I...
transcript.zh_text: 然后我按响了喇叭。我……

transcript.en_text: I remember him running.
transcript.zh_text: 我记得他跑了。

transcript.en_text: Like a blur, I got out.
transcript.zh_text: 我如同一道闪电般冲了出去。

transcript.en_text: I chased him.
transcript.zh_text: 我追了上去。

transcript.en_text: I'm not sure. I must have...
transcript.zh_text: 我不确定。我一定是...

transcript.en_text: What were you doing in that part of Maryland?
transcript.zh_text: 你当时在马里兰州的那片区域做什么？

transcript.en_text: Mr. Stamper?
transcript.zh_text: 斯坦普先生？

transcript.en_text: Sir. What were you doing in that part of Maryland?
transcript.zh_text: 先生。你当时在马里兰州的那片区域做什么？

transcript.en_text: I drive sometimes to think.
transcript.zh_text: 我有时会开车去思考问题。

transcript.en_text: There was a lot on my mind with work. I drive to clear my head.
transcript.zh_text: 工作上有很多事让我牵肠挂肚。我开车是为了理清思绪。

transcript.en_text: Have you found the car?
transcript.zh_text: 你找到车了吗？

transcript.en_text: We don't have anything other than what you just told us.
transcript.zh_text: 除了你刚才告诉我们的，我们没有其他任何线索了。

transcript.en_text: How's your mood been? Any episodes?
transcript.zh_text: 你最近情绪怎么样？有没有发作？

transcript.en_text: No. The meds are working.
transcript.zh_text: 没有。药起了作用。

transcript.en_text: You just telling me what I want to hear?
transcript.zh_text: 你是不是只是在说我想听的话？

transcript.en_text: No. I feel good.
transcript.zh_text: 没有。我感觉很好。

transcript.en_text: Okay.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。

transcript.en_text: I'm gonna sign your release today.
transcript.zh_text: 我今天会签署你的出院文件。

transcript.en_text: But it's important you take it easy at first.
transcript.zh_text: 但重要的是你一开始要放轻松。

transcript.en_text: Everything's gonna be much harder in general.
transcript.zh_text: 总的来说，一切都会变得更艰难。

transcript.en_text: I know.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道。

transcript.en_text: Do you have someone who can look after you?
transcript.zh_text: 有人能照顾你吗？

transcript.en_text: Yeah. My brother Gary's in from Ohio.
transcript.zh_text: 对。我哥哥盖瑞从俄亥俄州过来了。

transcript.en_text: Good. How long is he here for?
transcript.zh_text: 好。他会待多久？

transcript.en_text: - A while, I guess. - Okay, great.
transcript.zh_text: - 一阵子吧，我猜。 - 好的，太好了。

transcript.en_text: It's important you go to your meetings. Stay on top of your sobriety.
transcript.zh_text: 你去参加会议很重要。保持清醒。

transcript.en_text: Take this. It's for the steroids I prescribed you.
transcript.zh_text: 拿着。这是我给你开的类固醇。

transcript.en_text: It's one shot into the right thigh, once a week. The nurse, she...
transcript.zh_text: 每周一次，右大腿注射一针。护士，她...

transcript.en_text: - She showed me how. - Okay.
transcript.zh_text: - 她教过我了。 - 好的。

transcript.en_text: You do this?
transcript.zh_text: 你干的？

transcript.en_text: No, it wasn't me.
transcript.zh_text: 不，不是我。

transcript.en_text: I talked to my boss.
transcript.zh_text: 我跟老板谈过了。

transcript.en_text: I can stick around for another couple of weeks - while you transition back. - You should get back to your family.
transcript.zh_text: 我还可以再待几周，等你过渡回去。你该回到你家人身边了。

transcript.en_text: Nah... Sarah's fine with it.
transcript.zh_text: 没事... 莎拉没意见。

transcript.en_text: The kids are, too.
transcript.zh_text: 孩子们也没意见。

transcript.en_text: Gary, we've hardly spoken in ten years.
transcript.zh_text: 盖瑞，我们几乎十年没说话了。

transcript.en_text: You've already gone above and beyond.
transcript.zh_text: 你已经做得仁至义尽了。

transcript.en_text: All right. You want me to go?
transcript.zh_text: 好吧。你希望我走？

transcript.en_text: I'm fine.
transcript.zh_text: 我很好。

transcript.en_text: Thanks for everything.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你所做的一切。

transcript.en_text: Okay.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。

transcript.en_text: I mean, I'm just a phone call and a plane ticket away.
transcript.zh_text: 我的意思是，我随时都在，一个电话一张机票就能到。

highlights.en_word: a phone call and a plane ticket away
highlights.zh_word: 一个电话一张机票就能到

transcript.en_text: Safe travels.
transcript.zh_text: 旅途平安。

transcript.en_text: Uh...
Take care.
transcript.zh_text: 保重。

transcript.en_text: Hey, Gary, I...
transcript.zh_text: 嘿，盖瑞，我...

transcript.en_text: Send me some pictures of the kids.
transcript.zh_text: 给我发些孩子们的照片。

transcript.en_text: Yeah, I will.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，我会的。

transcript.en_text: But one of the things I admire about you is that in Washington, DC, which is so gridlocked, you get things done.
transcript.zh_text: 但我最欣赏你的一点是，在华盛顿特区，尽管那里政务如此僵持，你却能把事情办成。

transcript.en_text: And I understand you've got, um, a new piece of legislation, a major new initiative you're rolling out. What is it?
transcript.zh_text: 我听说你有一项新的立法，一项你正在推出的重大新举措。那是什么？

transcript.en_text: That is correct. It's a new jobs program that we're calling America Works.
transcript.zh_text: 没错。这是一个我们称之为“美国就业”的新就业计划。

transcript.en_text: Oh. So it's a fantasy novel.
transcript.zh_text: 哦。所以这是一本奇幻小说。

transcript.en_text: This is a fundamentally different look at how to solve the problem of unemployment.
transcript.zh_text: 这是一种从根本上解决失业问题的不同方法。

transcript.en_text: It has the size and the scope of the New Deal.
transcript.zh_text: 它的规模和范围与“新政”相当。

transcript.en_text: Oh. So it's a socialist redistribution of wealth wherein the baby boomers will latch onto the millennials like a lamprey and just keep sucking until they're as dry as a crouton?
transcript.zh_text: 哦。所以这是一种社会主义的财富再分配，婴儿潮一代会像七鳃鳗一样紧抓千禧一代，不断吸食，直到他们像面包丁一样干枯？

highlights.zh_word: 社会主义的财富再分配

transcript.en_text: This is about putting people to work and avoiding the entitlements entirely.
transcript.zh_text: 这关乎让人们就业，并完全避免福利。

transcript.en_text: Well, I like the sound of that.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，听起来不错。

transcript.en_text: So what, we're gonna privatize Social Security and then raise revenue by hunting the elderly for sport?
transcript.zh_text: 所以呢，我们要将社会保障私有化，然后通过以狩猎老年人取乐的方式来增加收入吗？

transcript.en_text: - Good plan. Use that. - No, as I said, this is a fundamentally different approach entirely.
transcript.zh_text: - 好计划。就用那个。- 不，就像我说的，这完全是一种根本不同的方法。

transcript.en_text: And you think that the Republicans in Congress will cooperate with you?
transcript.zh_text: 你认为国会里的共和党人会和你合作吗？

transcript.en_text: Oh, I think that it has been proved that both parties want the same thing.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，我认为已经证明，两党都想要同样的东西。

transcript.en_text: A new president in 2016?
transcript.zh_text: 2016年新总统？

transcript.en_text: No. No, I think actually, I think unemployment, eradicating it, and I think a strong economy is something both parties want.
transcript.zh_text: 不，不，我实际上认为，失业问题，以及根除它，我认为强大的经济是两党都希望的。

transcript.en_text: Okay, speaking of everyone, there's a recent poll by Reuters.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，说到大家，路透社最近做了一项民意调查。

transcript.en_text: I wanna get this right. It says that eight out of ten Americans agree that you lack, quote, "effectiveness and leadership."
transcript.zh_text: 我想确认一下。调查说十个美国人中有八个认为你缺乏，引用原话，“效率和领导力”。

transcript.en_text: Uh, look, I don't let polls like that bother me.
transcript.zh_text: 呃，听着，我不会让那样的民意调查困扰我。

transcript.en_text: I think that once the nation sees AmWorks in action, - they will change their attitudes. - I'm sorry, "AmWorks?"
transcript.zh_text: 我认为一旦全国看到AmWorks付诸行动，他们就会改变看法。抱歉，“AmWorks”？

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry-- I didn't realize it was called AmWorks.
transcript.zh_text: 抱歉——我不知道它叫AmWorks。

transcript.en_text: Is that like Amway? Is it a pyramid scheme?
transcript.zh_text: 那是像安利一样吗？是传销吗？

transcript.en_text: Is that what you're selling the American people?
transcript.zh_text: 那就是你卖给美国人民的东西吗？

transcript.en_text: No, it's actually just an abbreviation to make it easier to say.
transcript.zh_text: 不，它实际上只是一个缩写，为了更容易说出口。

transcript.en_text: Well, if you make it small enough, uh, maybe it'll be easier to swallow.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，如果你把它做得足够小，呃，也许会更容易让人接受。

transcript.en_text: You know, even though you're a Democrat, I respect you.
transcript.zh_text: 你知道，尽管你是个民主党人，但我尊重你。

transcript.en_text: But let's just take a look at the facts here for a second.
transcript.zh_text: 但我们先来看看这里的这些事实。

transcript.en_text: You've been president for six months, and again, I wanna get this right, unemployment has gone up, our trade deficit with China has increased, the number of vetoes has skyrocketed.
transcript.zh_text: 你已经当了六个月的总统了，我再说一遍，我想确认一下，失业率上升了，我们对华贸易逆差增加了，否决数量也急剧增加了。

transcript.en_text: I'm not entirely sure that I'm confident that you'll be able to eradicate unemployment the same way you've been able to eradicate your approval polls.
transcript.zh_text: 我不太确定是否有信心你能根除失业，就像你根除了自己的支持率调查一样。

transcript.en_text: What, you know, what do you-- How are you going to get it across to the American people?
transcript.zh_text: 你知道，你要怎么——你要怎么向美国人民说明白呢？

transcript.en_text: - Doug? - Seth?
transcript.zh_text: - 道格？ - 赛斯？

transcript.en_text: Yeah, it's me.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，是我。

transcript.en_text: Mrs. Underwood, she gave me this phone, but-- I know. Is something wrong?
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德夫人给了我这部电话，但是——我知道。出什么事了吗？

transcript.en_text: No. I want to speak to the president.
transcript.zh_text: 不。我想和总统通话。

transcript.en_text: Is it urgent?
transcript.zh_text: 很紧急吗？

transcript.en_text: I want to talk to him about the America Works program.
transcript.zh_text: 我想和他谈谈“美国工作”计划。

transcript.en_text: - So nothing urgent. - It's not an emergency, no.
transcript.zh_text: - 所以不紧急。 - 不是紧急情况，不。

transcript.en_text: 'Cause that's what this phone is for.
transcript.zh_text: 因为这部电话就是干这个用的。

transcript.en_text: Will you pass on my message?
transcript.zh_text: 你能帮我转达一下我的口信吗？

transcript.en_text: Ah!
transcript.zh_text: 啊！

transcript.en_text: Hey.
transcript.zh_text: 嘿。

transcript.en_text: You're late.
transcript.zh_text: 你迟到了。

transcript.en_text: I switched cabs three times.
transcript.zh_text: 我换了三次出租车。

transcript.en_text: - Were you being followed? - Didn't want to take chances.
transcript.zh_text: - 你被人跟踪了吗？ - 不想冒险。

transcript.en_text: - You know why I asked you here. - I don't know where she is.
transcript.zh_text: - 你知道我为什么叫你来。 - 我不知道她在哪里。

transcript.en_text: - Then you need to find out. - I ran her social, her name, police records, taxes, everything.
transcript.zh_text: - 那你需要查出来。 - 我查了她的社保、姓名、警方记录、税务，所有一切。

transcript.en_text: She could be tossed in a ditch by a john for all I know.
transcript.zh_text: 据我所知，她可能被一个嫖客扔到沟里了。

transcript.en_text: - You work at the FBI. - What do I get in return?
transcript.zh_text: - 你在联邦调查局工作。 - 我能得到什么回报？

transcript.en_text: My protection, like you asked.
transcript.zh_text: 我的保护，就像你要求的那样。

transcript.en_text: I thought you had something to offer. Something real.
transcript.zh_text: 我以为你有什么能提供的。一些实在的东西。

transcript.en_text: Like money?
transcript.zh_text: 比如钱？

transcript.en_text: Like getting me out of the Bureau. You make that happen, maybe I can help you.
transcript.zh_text: 比如让我离开联邦调查局。如果你能做到，也许我能帮你。

transcript.en_text: That was a condition, for your charges being dropped.
transcript.zh_text: 那是一个条件，为了撤销你的指控。

transcript.en_text: See, you don't still know people.
transcript.zh_text: 看来，你已经不认识人了。

transcript.en_text: - I shouldn't have even come here. - I am your only safety net.
transcript.zh_text: - 我根本就不该来这里。 - 我是你唯一的安全网。

transcript.en_text: You think I would have turned over all the AT&T records without leaving a backup with somebody?
transcript.zh_text: 你以为我会把所有AT&T的记录都交出去，而不留一份备份给别人吗？

transcript.en_text: I'm not gonna blow my get-out-of-jail card on a wild goose chase.
transcript.zh_text: 我不会把我的免死金牌浪费在一场徒劳无功的追逐上。

transcript.en_text: Does anyone suspect anything?
transcript.zh_text: 有人怀疑什么吗？

transcript.en_text: At the Bureau?
transcript.zh_text: 在调查局？

transcript.en_text: Nobody has a clue about her.
transcript.zh_text: 没有人知道她的任何线索。

transcript.en_text: If that gives you any peace of mind.
transcript.zh_text: 如果这能让你安心的话。

transcript.en_text: Doug?
transcript.zh_text: 道格？

transcript.en_text: Tell him it's urgent.
transcript.zh_text: 告诉他事情很紧急。

transcript.en_text: We're aiming for sometime in May.
transcript.zh_text: 我们的目标是五月的某个时候。

transcript.en_text: As soon as we agree on a date with the Russian delegation, you will be the first to know. Uh, Greg.
transcript.zh_text: 一旦我们与俄罗斯代表团确定了日期，你将是第一个知道的。格雷格。

transcript.en_text: The Summit with Petrov here in Washington, what'll be the focus of the talks?
transcript.zh_text: 与彼得罗夫在华盛顿举行的峰会，会谈的重点是什么？

transcript.en_text: A bilateral approach to the Middle East.
transcript.zh_text: 对中东采取双边方针。

transcript.en_text: As you know, the Palestinians have refused to negotiate until Israeli troops leave the Jordan Valley.
transcript.zh_text: 如你所知，巴勒斯坦人拒绝谈判，直到以色列军队撤出约旦河谷。

transcript.en_text: We hope to address this with President Petrov so that we can move on to a whole host of other issues.
transcript.zh_text: 我们希望与彼得罗夫总统解决这个问题，以便我们可以继续处理一系列其他问题。

transcript.en_text: Sara.
transcript.zh_text: 莎拉。

transcript.en_text: So this bilateral approach doesn't include Israel and Palestine.
transcript.zh_text: 所以这种双边方针不包括以色列和巴勒斯坦。

transcript.en_text: The State Department is briefing all interested parties.
transcript.zh_text: 国务院正在向所有相关方通报情况。

transcript.en_text: The summit's really just a first step. Ayla.
transcript.zh_text: 峰会真的只是第一步。艾拉。

transcript.en_text: I'd like to change course to the America Works program.
transcript.zh_text: 我想把话题转到“美国工作计划”上。

transcript.en_text: Please.
transcript.zh_text: 请。

transcript.en_text: I've spoken to a number of the president's policy advisors, who say there's been a lot of disagreement on the economic team as to exactly what form this jobs package should take.
transcript.zh_text: 我和总统的几位政策顾问谈过，他们说经济团队对于这项就业计划具体应采取何种形式存在很多分歧。

transcript.en_text: - Which advisors? - Nice try.
transcript.zh_text: - 哪些顾问？ - 别想了。

transcript.en_text: To be clear, this is far more than just a jobs package.
transcript.zh_text: 澄清一下，这远不止是一个就业计划。

transcript.en_text: It is a comprehensive plan, which aims at full employment within two years.
transcript.zh_text: 这是一项综合计划，目标是在两年内实现充分就业。

transcript.en_text: So as such, there are a lot of details to be worked out.
transcript.zh_text: 因此，有很多细节有待敲定。

transcript.en_text: So your sources are inaccurate.
transcript.zh_text: 所以你的消息来源不准确。

transcript.en_text: It's not so much a disagreement as it is debating the finer points of the plan. Jess.
transcript.zh_text: 这与其说是一场分歧，不如说是对计划的细枝末节进行辩论。杰斯。

transcript.en_text: Just to follow up. What are some of the finer points?
transcript.zh_text: 我想接着追问一下。有哪些细枝末节？

transcript.en_text: Or the broad strokes, even. No one from the White House has said anything.
transcript.zh_text: 甚至是大致方针。白宫没有人说过任何话。

transcript.en_text: When we have a plan to present, we will present it.
transcript.zh_text: 当我们有计划要提出时，我们会提出的。

transcript.en_text: Jess?
transcript.zh_text: 杰斯？

transcript.en_text: Is America Works a reaction to the president's low approval ratings?
transcript.zh_text: “美国工作计划”是对总统低支持率的回应吗？

transcript.en_text: An effort to offer some sign of progress ramping up to the elections?
transcript.zh_text: 这是一个在选举前加紧取得进展的努力吗？

transcript.en_text: We've been working on this plan since day one.
transcript.zh_text: 我们从第一天起就在制定这项计划。

transcript.en_text: It has nothing to do with the approval ratings.
transcript.zh_text: 这与支持率无关。

transcript.en_text: But as for the election... uh, whose turn is it to ask today?
transcript.zh_text: 但至于选举……呃，今天轮到谁提问了？

transcript.en_text: - Mark? - Is the president running in 2016?
transcript.zh_text: - 马克？ - 总统会在2016年参选吗？

transcript.en_text: Today, the priority is good government, but...
transcript.zh_text: 今天，首要任务是良好施政，但……

transcript.en_text: Ask me again tomorrow.
transcript.zh_text: 明天再问我吧。

transcript.en_text: Thank you, everyone.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢大家。

transcript.en_text: We've got a window at ten.
transcript.zh_text: 我们十点有一个空档。

transcript.en_text: I'll call him now.
transcript.zh_text: 我现在就给他打电话。

transcript.en_text: Please, sit down.
transcript.zh_text: 请坐。

transcript.en_text: John. Samantha.
transcript.zh_text: 约翰。萨曼莎。

transcript.en_text: You spoke to a journalist about disagreements in this room?
transcript.zh_text: 你跟记者谈论过这个房间里的分歧？

transcript.en_text: If that happens again, you're off the team.
transcript.zh_text: 如果再发生这种事，你就会被踢出团队。

transcript.en_text: And speaking of the disagreements in this room, we now have an even bigger one, because Remy has shown me your work so far and...
transcript.zh_text: 提到这个房间里的分歧，我们现在有一个更大的分歧，因为雷米已经给我看了你们目前为止的工作，而且...

transcript.en_text: it's toothless.
transcript.zh_text: 它苍白无力。

transcript.en_text: I stood in this room three months ago and gave you all very clear direction.
transcript.zh_text: 三个月前我站在这间屋子里，给你们所有人指明了非常明确的方向。

transcript.en_text: Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, every entitlement program that is sucking us dry, I want it all on the table. And this doesn't go nearly far enough.
transcript.zh_text: 社会保障、医疗保险、医疗补助，每一个正在耗尽我们资源的福利项目，我希望它们全部摆到台面上来讨论。而这根本不够。

transcript.en_text: So we obviously have to get back to some basics.
transcript.zh_text: 所以我们显然必须回归一些基本的东西。

transcript.en_text: Remind ourselves of some of the facts that are before us-- - Sir, if I may-- - No, no, no, no.
transcript.zh_text: 提醒我们自己面前的一些事实—— 先生，如果我可以—— 不，不，不，不。

transcript.en_text: I will speak first, and then you will speak, Paul.
transcript.zh_text: 我先说，然后你再说，保罗。

transcript.en_text: This is what the average senior citizen gets, one year from entitlements, whether they were a janitor or they ran a hedge fund.
transcript.zh_text: 这是一个普通老年公民一年从福利项目中获得的，无论他们是清洁工还是经营对冲基金的。

transcript.en_text: That-- This money is a job we could be giving to a single mother or a student just out of school.
transcript.zh_text: 这笔钱是我们本可以提供给单身母亲或刚毕业学生的就业机会。

transcript.en_text: Now, at the moment, 44 cents of every tax dollar goes to pay for these programs.
transcript.zh_text: 现在，目前，每一美元税款中有44美分用于支付这些项目。

transcript.en_text: By 2030, it'll be over half, 62 cents.
transcript.zh_text: 到2030年，将超过一半，达到62美分。

transcript.en_text: Entitlements are bankrupting us.
transcript.zh_text: 福利项目正在使我们破产。

transcript.en_text: Now, I had Remy conduct a little poll.
transcript.zh_text: 现在，我让雷米进行了一次小调查。

transcript.en_text: "Doing what's best for my country means doing some things that I don't like."
transcript.zh_text: “为我的国家做最好的事意味着做一些我不喜欢的事。”

transcript.en_text: Seventy-four percent agreed with this statement.
transcript.zh_text: 百分之七十四的人同意这一说法。

transcript.en_text: Seventy-four percent. Now, what does that tell us?
transcript.zh_text: 百分之七十四。这说明了什么？

transcript.en_text: We have to do the things that people won't like.
transcript.zh_text: 我们必须做那些人们不喜欢的事情。

transcript.en_text: And even when we do, three out of four of them will go along with us.
transcript.zh_text: 即使我们这样做了，他们中也有四分之三的人会同意我们的做法。

transcript.en_text: And why? Because we're promising jobs.
transcript.zh_text: 为什么？因为我们承诺提供就业机会。

transcript.en_text: And again, where are the three areas that we're gonna be creating these jobs from?
transcript.zh_text: 那么，我们将在哪三个领域创造这些就业机会呢？

transcript.en_text: Infrastructure at the state and federal level.
transcript.zh_text: 州和联邦层面的基础设施建设。

transcript.en_text: Increasing the size of the military, and working with our friends in the private sector to start-- I'm sorry, sir, but I have to interrupt.
transcript.zh_text: 扩充军队规模，并与私营部门的朋友合作开始——抱歉，先生，但我必须打断一下。

transcript.en_text: The programs that you want to scale back or dismantle are the bedrock of the American dream.
transcript.zh_text: 你想缩减或废除的那些项目，曾是美国梦的基石。

transcript.en_text: You work hard, you pay your taxes-- No, I'm sorry, they were the bedrock of the American dream.
transcript.zh_text: 你努力工作，你纳税——不，抱歉，它们曾是美国梦的基石。

transcript.en_text: But they're not anymore.
transcript.zh_text: 但它们现在已经不是了。

transcript.en_text: Certainly not for the ten million people who are out of work.
transcript.zh_text: 对于那千万失业人口来说，肯定不是。

transcript.en_text: But practically speaking, a thousand special interests, organized labor, opposition in both parties.
transcript.zh_text: 但实际来说，有成千上万的特殊利益团体、有组织的工会以及两党内部的反对势力。

transcript.en_text: Now, we can do a version of what you're proposing-- I don't want a version.
transcript.zh_text: 我们可以做你提议的一个“版本”——我不要一个“版本”。

transcript.en_text: I want a vision.
transcript.zh_text: 我要一个“愿景”。

transcript.en_text: As head of this team, and I think I speak for everyone, - we have done-- - Speaking as the president, who chose this team and for whom it works, I want five hundred billion dollars to put ten million people to work.
transcript.zh_text: 作为这个团队的负责人，我认为我代表大家发言，——我们已经做了——作为选择这个团队并为其工作的总统，我需要五千亿美元来让一千万失业人口重新就业。

highlights.en_word: put ten million people to work
highlights.zh_word: 让一千万失业人口重新就业

transcript.en_text: I don't care how much it hurts.
transcript.zh_text: 我不在乎会带来多大痛苦。

transcript.en_text: I don't care how controversial it is.
transcript.zh_text: 我不在乎它有多具争议性。

transcript.en_text: Your job is to find a way.
transcript.zh_text: 你们的工作就是想办法。

transcript.en_text: It's my job to convince Congress and the American people.
transcript.zh_text: 我的工作是说服国会和美国人民。

transcript.en_text: Your job is not to sell me on your version of my program.
transcript.zh_text: 你的工作不是向我推销你对我程序的理解。

transcript.en_text: Now, are we all clear on what our jobs are?
transcript.zh_text: 现在，我们都清楚自己的职责了吗？

transcript.en_text: Good, because I want to present this proposal to leadership in 30 days.
transcript.zh_text: 很好，因为我希望在30天内向领导层提交这份提案。

transcript.en_text: - Let's make it happen. - Paul?
transcript.zh_text: - 让我们实现它。 - 保罗？

transcript.en_text: - Your services are no longer needed. - Excuse me?
transcript.zh_text: - 你的服务不再需要了。 - 你说什么？

transcript.en_text: Let's keep it quiet, let's keep it cordial.
transcript.zh_text: 我们安静点，客气点。

transcript.en_text: - Thanks for all your work. - I'll get my things.
transcript.zh_text: - 感谢你的所有工作。 - 我去拿我的东西。

transcript.en_text: I'll have them sent down to you in the lobby.
transcript.zh_text: 我会让人把它们送到大堂给你。

transcript.en_text: Hello?
transcript.zh_text: 你好？

transcript.en_text: Yeah. I'm on my way.
transcript.zh_text: 是啊。我正在路上。

transcript.en_text: Ah! Oh!
transcript.zh_text: 啊！哦！

transcript.en_text: Ah! God!
transcript.zh_text: 啊！天啊！

transcript.en_text: Ah!
transcript.zh_text: 啊！

transcript.en_text: Oh!
transcript.zh_text: 哦！

transcript.en_text: Ah!
transcript.zh_text: 啊！

transcript.en_text: Ah!
transcript.zh_text: 啊！

transcript.en_text: Mm...
Ahh!
transcript.zh_text: 啊！

transcript.en_text: God!
transcript.zh_text: 天啊！

transcript.en_text: It'll be a few minutes. Please, have a seat.
transcript.zh_text: 还要几分钟。请坐。

transcript.en_text: - How long have you known? - Two months.
transcript.zh_text: “你什么时候知道的？”“两个月前。”

transcript.en_text: It hasn't impaired my judgment on the bench.
transcript.zh_text: 这没有影响我在法官席上的判断。

transcript.en_text: And it's early on. We don't expect any real symptoms for quite some time.
transcript.zh_text: 而且现在还早。我们预计在相当长一段时间内都不会出现真正的症状。

transcript.en_text: I won't be wandering around the Supreme Court in my boxer shorts anytime soon.
transcript.zh_text: 我近期内不会穿着我的平角短裤在最高法院里到处乱晃。

transcript.en_text: But I'd like to retire now, long before we get there.
transcript.zh_text: 但我想现在就退休，在事情发展到那个地步之前很久。

transcript.en_text: Well, Justice, I want to thank you for having the courage to come and share this news with me. Are you sure the diagnosis is correct?
transcript.zh_text: 好的，大法官，感谢您有勇气来与我分享这个消息。您确定诊断结果正确吗？

transcript.en_text: My doctor's the same that treated the vice president's wife.
transcript.zh_text: 我的医生和治疗副总统妻子的那位是同一个人。

transcript.en_text: He's the foremost Alzheimer's specialist in America.
transcript.zh_text: 他更是美国最杰出的阿尔茨海默病专家。

transcript.en_text: Yes, I made Donald my vice president.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，我让唐纳德当我的副总统。

transcript.en_text: I'd rather him be a pain in my ass here than over in Congress.
transcript.zh_text: 我宁愿他在这里让我头疼，也不愿他在国会捣乱。

transcript.en_text: And even the Republicans couldn't refuse a man who just buried his wife.
transcript.zh_text: 甚至共和党人都无法拒绝一个刚埋葬了他妻子的男人。

transcript.en_text: Terrible how quickly Marjory went.
transcript.zh_text: 玛乔丽走得太快了，真可怕。

transcript.en_text: I'm telling you this now so you have time to think about candidates before I announce my retirement.
transcript.zh_text: 我现在告诉你这件事，这样你就有时间在我宣布退休前考虑候选人。

transcript.en_text: - How much time can you give me? - How much do you need?
transcript.zh_text: “你能给我多少时间？”“你需要多少？”

transcript.en_text: I'm about to introduce America Works to Congress.
transcript.zh_text: 我即将向国会提出“美国就业计划”。

transcript.en_text: It's sure to be an uphill battle. And I'd prefer not to add a Supreme Court nomination to the mix.
transcript.zh_text: 这肯定是一场艰苦的战斗。我不想再给这件事添上最高法院的提名。

transcript.en_text: The Republicans will just use it as leverage.
transcript.zh_text: 共和党人只会以此作为筹码。

transcript.en_text: I've heard rumblings. Entitlements on the chopping block?
transcript.zh_text: 我听到了一些传闻。福利项目要被砍掉吗？

transcript.en_text: All the more reason to keep you on the bench.
transcript.zh_text: 这更是一个让你留在法官席上的理由。

transcript.en_text: It's sure to be challenged in the Judiciary.
transcript.zh_text: 这肯定会在司法部门受到挑战。

transcript.en_text: Mr. President, I want to spend as much time with my wife as possible in the good years that I have left.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生，在余下的美好岁月里，我希望能尽可能多地陪伴我的妻子。

transcript.en_text: When Marjory was ill, she wanted the same thing.
transcript.zh_text: 玛乔丽生病时，她也想要同样的事情。

transcript.en_text: She left the Smithsonian, and you know what?
transcript.zh_text: 她离开了史密森尼博物馆，你猜怎么着？

transcript.en_text: She hated every second of being at home, of not being productive, of not doing what she loved.
transcript.zh_text: 她讨厌在家里的每一秒，讨厌不思进取，讨厌不能做自己喜欢的事情。

transcript.en_text: It made her time with us much harder, and...
transcript.zh_text: 这让她的生活变得更加艰难，而且……

transcript.en_text: it made her deeply unhappy.
transcript.zh_text: 这让她非常不开心。

transcript.en_text: Work is the best distraction. I wish she hadn't retired.
transcript.zh_text: 工作是最好的消遣。我希望她没有退休。

transcript.en_text: And, uh... before she lost her lucid thought, she said she regretted it, too.
transcript.zh_text: 而且，在她失去清醒的思维能力之前，她也说过她很后悔。

transcript.en_text: Can you give me six months? A year at the most? That's all.
transcript.zh_text: 你能给我六个月吗？最多一年？就这些。

transcript.en_text: Just enough time to get this program up and running before I have to face a Supreme Court fight.
transcript.zh_text: 只要足够的时间让这个项目启动并运行起来，在我不得不面对最高法院的斗争之前。

transcript.en_text: - I need to think it over. - Oh, of course.
transcript.zh_text: - 我需要仔细考虑一下。- 哦，当然。

transcript.en_text: - Speak to your wife. - I'll walk you out.
transcript.zh_text: - 和你妻子谈谈吧。- 我送你出去。

transcript.en_text: - I better get that research center. - Yes, a deal is a deal.
transcript.zh_text: - 我最好拿到那个研究中心。- 是的，一言为定。

transcript.en_text: Now, good God, Donald, let's get something done.
transcript.zh_text: 好了，天哪，唐纳德，我们赶紧把事情办妥吧。

transcript.en_text: Now you see why Donald said yes.
transcript.zh_text: 现在你明白为什么唐纳德会答应了。

transcript.en_text: He may hate my guts, but there's nothing like a death in the family to separate the wheat from the bullshit.
transcript.zh_text: 他可能恨透了我，但没有什么比家里的死亡更能辨别真伪了。

highlights.en_word: separate the wheat from the bullshit

transcript.en_text: Send him in.
transcript.zh_text: 让他进来。

transcript.en_text: Yes, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，先生。

transcript.en_text: The president is ready to see you now.
transcript.zh_text: 总统现在准备见你。

transcript.en_text: Doug.
transcript.zh_text: 道格。

transcript.en_text: Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生。

transcript.en_text: The doctor told me your recovery is going very well.
transcript.zh_text: 医生告诉我你恢复得很好。

transcript.en_text: Yeah. Well, there's this.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯。嗯，有这个。

transcript.en_text: But everything else is as good as new.
transcript.zh_text: 但其他一切都完好如初。

transcript.en_text: It's great to see you.
transcript.zh_text: 很高兴见到你。

transcript.en_text: Claire and I have been worried sick about you.
transcript.zh_text: 克莱尔和我一直为你担心坏了。

transcript.en_text: Thank you for the gifts.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你的礼物。

transcript.en_text: - Well... - For looking out for me.
transcript.zh_text: - 嗯... - 谢谢你照顾我。

transcript.en_text: I don't have that many close friends. I count you among them.
transcript.zh_text: 我没有那么多亲密的朋友。我把你算在其中。

transcript.en_text: - I appreciate your saying that, sir. - Oh, drop the "sir." We're old pals.
transcript.zh_text: - 感谢你这么说，先生。 - 哦，别叫‘先生’了。我们是老朋友了。

transcript.en_text: Well...
I'm the one who should apologize.
transcript.zh_text: 我才是应该道歉的人。

transcript.en_text: You gave me another chance. You trusted me.
transcript.zh_text: 你又给了我一次机会。你信任我。

transcript.en_text: And what happened, I take responsibility for that.
transcript.zh_text: 所发生的一切，我为此负责。

transcript.en_text: - No, for putting you in that position. - Stop. It's not necessary.
transcript.zh_text: - 不，是我让你陷入那种境地。 - 停。没必要。

transcript.en_text: - I endangered you just as-- - Yeah, but all I care about is that you are alive and getting better.
transcript.zh_text: - 我危及了你—— - 是的，但我只关心你还活着并且在好转。

transcript.en_text: Let the rest of it go.
transcript.zh_text: 让过去的事过去吧。

highlights.en_word: Let the rest of it go

transcript.en_text: - You know how devoted I am. - You don't have to say it.
transcript.zh_text: - 你知道我有多么忠诚。 - 你不必说了。

transcript.en_text: You proved it time and time again.
transcript.zh_text: 你一次又一次地证明了这一点。

transcript.en_text: Now, come on, come on, sit down.
transcript.zh_text: 来吧，来吧，坐下。

transcript.en_text: Right here.
transcript.zh_text: 就在这里。

transcript.en_text: I should've taken care of her when I had the chance.
transcript.zh_text: 我本该在有机会的时候照顾好她的。

transcript.en_text: I haven't found her yet.
transcript.zh_text: 我还没找到她。

transcript.en_text: But when I do, I'll make sure that no one else does.
transcript.zh_text: 但当我找到她时，我会确保没有人再能伤害她。

transcript.en_text: You can count on that, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 这您大可放心，先生。

transcript.en_text: How is it, uh...?
transcript.zh_text: 怎么样，嗯……？

transcript.en_text: Probably better if we don't talk about it.
transcript.zh_text: 我们最好还是别谈论这件事了。

transcript.en_text: Right, of course.
transcript.zh_text: 对，当然了。

transcript.en_text: Well, they told me you needed to see me.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，他们告诉我你需要见我。

transcript.en_text: Well, sir, I... I know that it's a lot to ask, and that I probably don't deserve it, considering the mess I put us in.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，先生，我知道这要求很高，而且考虑到我给我们造成的烂摊子，我可能不配得到它。

highlights.en_word: the mess I put us in
highlights.zh_word: 我给我们造成的烂摊子

transcript.en_text: And I'm sure you have your doubts.
transcript.zh_text: 而且我确信您对此有所疑虑。

transcript.en_text: I realize it couldn't be anything too visible, but...
transcript.zh_text: 我明白这不可能是太显眼的事情，但是……

transcript.en_text: I've been following everything with America Works.
transcript.zh_text: 我一直在关注着美国就业计划的一切进展。

transcript.en_text: - Oh. Well, that's a ways off. - But I was thinking that I could help.
transcript.zh_text: 哦。嗯，那还有很长一段路要走。但是我当时在想我或许能帮上忙。

transcript.en_text: There should be a targeted plan for lobbying committee leadership.
transcript.zh_text: 应该有一个针对游说委员会领导层的专项计划。

transcript.en_text: And I can work with the political team, coordinate with House leg directors, chiefs of staff-- I was in Gaffney yesterday, visiting my father's grave.
transcript.zh_text: 我可以和政治团队合作，协调众议院立法主任、幕僚长的工作——我昨天在加夫尼，祭拜了我父亲的坟墓。

transcript.en_text: He never took care of himself.
transcript.zh_text: 他从不照顾自己。

transcript.en_text: He ignored his heart problems and... he paid the price.
transcript.zh_text: 他忽视了自己的心脏问题，然后……他付出了代价。

transcript.en_text: You have to respect your own mortality, Doug.
transcript.zh_text: 道格，你必须尊重自己的生命有限。

transcript.en_text: I don't want to be standing over your grave.
transcript.zh_text: 我不想站在你的坟墓旁。

transcript.en_text: Now, look...
transcript.zh_text: 现在，你看...

transcript.en_text: There is a place for you here, I promise.
transcript.zh_text: 这里有你的一席之地，我保证。

transcript.en_text: But we have to go about this slowly.
transcript.zh_text: 但我们必须循序渐进地处理这件事。

transcript.en_text: I'll work from home. Only direct contact with you or Remy.
transcript.zh_text: 我会在家工作。只和你或雷米直接联系。

transcript.en_text: You know the way that you can help me the best is to do exactly what you're doing right now, focusing on your recovery.
transcript.zh_text: 你知道你帮我最好的方式，就是现在你正在做的，专注于你的康复。

transcript.en_text: I would never forgive myself if I put too much on your plate too soon.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我太早给你太大的压力，我永远不会原谅自己。

highlights.en_word: put too much on your plate

transcript.en_text: You're right.
transcript.zh_text: 你说得对。

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry.
transcript.zh_text: 我很抱歉。

transcript.en_text: Thank you.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你。

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry, I have to go.
transcript.zh_text: 抱歉，我得走了。

transcript.en_text: But look, I meant what I said.
transcript.zh_text: 但是，听着，我说的话是认真的。

transcript.en_text: When you are truly ready.
transcript.zh_text: 等你真正准备好了。

transcript.en_text: Yes, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，先生。

transcript.en_text: Stay as long as you like.
transcript.zh_text: 你想待多久就待多久。

transcript.en_text: Three hours ago, we pinpointed him here, in the Shabwa region of Yemen.
transcript.zh_text: 三小时前，我们在这里，在也门的沙卜瓦地区，确定了他的位置。

transcript.en_text: Cooperation?
transcript.zh_text: 合作吗？

transcript.en_text: I spoke to the foreign minister a few minutes ago.
transcript.zh_text: 几分钟前我跟外交部长谈过了。

transcript.en_text: - Civilians? - Two dozen, non-IDs.
transcript.zh_text: - 平民？ - 两打，身份不明。

transcript.en_text: That's too many.
transcript.zh_text: 那太多了。

transcript.en_text: Our concern is that he could be on the move at any moment.
transcript.zh_text: 我们担心他随时可能转移。

transcript.en_text: Sir, with Petrov coming to Washington-- It's taken us two years to track Abdullah down.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，彼得罗夫要来华盛顿了——我们花了两年时间才追踪到阿卜杜拉。

transcript.en_text: We can't ignore every opportunity between now and the summit.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不能忽视从现在到峰会之间的每一个机会。

transcript.en_text: Do you have eyes on the village?
transcript.zh_text: 你们盯住那个村庄了吗？

transcript.en_text: Yes, sir. He's in this building here.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，先生。他就在这栋楼里。

transcript.en_text: Kill zone is anyone within 50 meters.
transcript.zh_text: 杀伤区是五十米范围内的所有人。

transcript.en_text: If we take him out with no civilian casualties, I'll authorize the strike.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我们能在没有平民伤亡的情况下解决他，我就会批准这次打击。

transcript.en_text: Sir, if I may, I really think-- President Petrov is coming to Washington in less than two months.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，如果可以的话，我真的认为——彼得罗夫总统将在不到两个月内抵达华盛顿。

transcript.en_text: Our entire Middle East policy hinges on that meeting.
transcript.zh_text: 我们整个中东政策都取决于那次会议。

transcript.en_text: We don't want to give the Muslim community any viable reasons to obstruct things if we can avoid it.
transcript.zh_text: 如果可以避免的话，我们不想给穆斯林社区任何合理的理由来阻碍事情。

transcript.en_text: So find a way to do this without killing civilians.
transcript.zh_text: 所以，想办法在不伤害平民的情况下完成这件事。

transcript.en_text: Thank you all very much.
transcript.zh_text: 非常感谢大家。

transcript.en_text: May I have a moment? It's about Claire.
transcript.zh_text: 我能说句话吗？是关于克莱尔的。

transcript.en_text: If your husband nominates you, I can't pull any punches.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你丈夫提名你，我就会直言不讳。

transcript.en_text: Lack of experience. Nepotism.
transcript.zh_text: 缺乏经验。裙带关系。

transcript.en_text: That's right.
transcript.zh_text: 没错。

transcript.en_text: - And you think I'm a dilettante. - No. But plenty of people will.
transcript.zh_text: - 你觉得我是个半吊子。 - 不。但很多人都会这么想。

transcript.en_text: I've been preparing since Francis took office.
transcript.zh_text: 自从弗朗西斯上任以来，我就一直在做准备。

transcript.en_text: What I lack in experience I'll make up for in work ethic.
transcript.zh_text: 我缺乏的经验，我会用职业道德来弥补。

transcript.en_text: Why Ambassador to the UN?
transcript.zh_text: 为什么要当联合国大使？

transcript.en_text: You wield far more influence as the First Lady.
transcript.zh_text: 作为第一夫人，你拥有更大的影响力。

transcript.en_text: That's not the same as contributing in a concrete way.
transcript.zh_text: 这与以具体方式做出贡献是不同的。

transcript.en_text: If we vote down your confirmation, are you comfortable with that sort of public embarrassment?
transcript.zh_text: 如果我们否决你的提名，你对那种公开的尴尬感到舒服吗？

transcript.en_text: I know that's a risk.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道那是个风险。

transcript.en_text: - You're running in 2016, right? - No comment.
transcript.zh_text: - 你要参加2016年的竞选，对吗？ - 不予置评。

transcript.en_text: Francis and I are impressed by how the Republicans are consolidating around you.
transcript.zh_text: 弗朗西斯和我对共和党人如何围绕你巩固势力印象深刻。

transcript.en_text: You'll make a good candidate.
transcript.zh_text: 你会是个好候选人。

transcript.en_text: Not by linking arms with the president's wife.
transcript.zh_text: 不是通过与总统夫人联手。

transcript.en_text: If I'm a disaster, it makes for a good campaign ad.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我搞砸了，那就会成为一个不错的竞选广告。

transcript.en_text: If I do a good job, nobody can fault you.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我做得好，没人能指责你。

transcript.en_text: Either way, it doesn't hurt your chances in 2016.
transcript.zh_text: 无论哪种方式，都不会损害你2016年的机会。

transcript.en_text: Well, I appreciate you coming by before going public.
transcript.zh_text: 好了，我很感谢你在公开之前来找我。

transcript.en_text: It is classy, and thoughtful.
transcript.zh_text: 这很得体，也很周到。

transcript.en_text: I won't actively block you.
transcript.zh_text: 我不会主动阻挠你。

transcript.en_text: The rest is on your shoulders.
transcript.zh_text: 剩下的就看你的了。

transcript.en_text: Thank you, Senator.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你，参议员。

transcript.en_text: Tell the president I'm doing this out of respect to you.
transcript.zh_text: 告诉总统，我这样做是出于对你的尊重。

transcript.en_text: Frank's still on my shit list till I beat him in the general.
transcript.zh_text: 弗兰克还在我的黑名单上，直到我在大选中击败他。

transcript.en_text: I will.
transcript.zh_text: 我会的。

transcript.en_text: Why didn't you come right away?
transcript.zh_text: 你为什么不马上来？

transcript.en_text: I had a meeting I couldn't miss.
transcript.zh_text: 我有个会不能错过。

transcript.en_text: Fucking Washington.
transcript.zh_text: 该死的华盛顿。

transcript.en_text: - This is gonna hurt. - I know.
transcript.zh_text: - 这会很痛的。 - 我知道。

transcript.en_text: Ah!
transcript.zh_text: 啊！

transcript.en_text: Here's some Percocet. It'll help with the pain.
transcript.zh_text: 这是些羟考酮。它会帮你止痛的。

transcript.en_text: I'll write you a 30-day prescription.
transcript.zh_text: 我给你开30天的处方。

transcript.en_text: I can't.
transcript.zh_text: 我不能。

transcript.en_text: - I'm not supposed to-- - What was that?
transcript.zh_text: - 我不应该—— - 那是什么？

transcript.en_text: Nothing.
transcript.zh_text: 没什么。

transcript.en_text: All right. You're good to go.
transcript.zh_text: 好了。你可以走了。

transcript.en_text: Hey.
transcript.zh_text: 嘿。

transcript.en_text: - How did it go with Mendoza? - Well, I think.
transcript.zh_text: - 和门多萨谈得怎么样？ - 嗯，我觉得还行。

transcript.en_text: He'll support you?
transcript.zh_text: 他会支持你吗？

transcript.en_text: He won't openly fight it.
transcript.zh_text: 他不会公开反对的。

transcript.en_text: Well, that is a big step forward.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，那是一大进步。

transcript.en_text: - How did it go with Doug? - No real news.
transcript.zh_text: - 和道格谈得怎么样？ - 没什么实质性进展。

transcript.en_text: Hey, are you in here again tonight?
transcript.zh_text: 嘿，你今晚又在这里吗？

transcript.en_text: I'm still getting over this cold. I don't want to get you sick.
transcript.zh_text: 我还在从感冒中恢复。我不想传染给你。

transcript.en_text: Well, don't stay up with all that too late.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，别熬夜太晚了。

transcript.en_text: Francis?
transcript.zh_text: 弗朗西斯？

transcript.en_text: When do we announce the nomination?
transcript.zh_text: 我们什么时候宣布提名？

transcript.en_text: Listen, I wasn't gonna bring this up tonight, but you should know that there are some serious doubts from people at the State Department.
transcript.zh_text: 听着，我今晚不打算提这事，但你应该知道，国务院有人对这事有严重疑虑。

transcript.en_text: You mean Cathy.
transcript.zh_text: 你是指凯茜。

transcript.en_text: And some on her staff.
transcript.zh_text: 还有她手下的一些人。

transcript.en_text: Like what?
transcript.zh_text: 比如什么？

transcript.en_text: Well, in over your head, wearing two hats, the obvious things.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，力不从心，身兼二职，显而易见的事情。

transcript.en_text: And are you saying this because you don't want to move forward?
transcript.zh_text: 你说这些是因为你不想推进吗？

transcript.en_text: Not at all. I'm sharing with you so you fully understand - what you're getting into. - And I do.
transcript.zh_text: 完全不是。我跟你说这些是为了让你充分理解——你卷入了什么。——我明白。

transcript.en_text: Maybe we shouldn't rush this.
transcript.zh_text: 也许我们不该仓促行事。

transcript.en_text: - You're having doubts now, too. - I didn't say that.
transcript.zh_text: - 你现在也有疑虑了。 - 我没那么说。

transcript.en_text: Only you should put more thought into whether this is the right move for you. That's all.
transcript.zh_text: 只是你应该多考虑一下，这对你来说是不是正确的决定。仅此而已。

transcript.en_text: Good night, Francis.
transcript.zh_text: 晚安，弗朗西斯。

transcript.en_text: Feel better.
transcript.zh_text: 感觉好点了吗？

transcript.en_text: Francis.
transcript.zh_text: 弗朗西斯。

transcript.en_text: I want you to announce the nomination this week.
transcript.zh_text: 我希望你这周宣布提名。

transcript.en_text: I don't want to wait. The timing will never be good.
transcript.zh_text: 我不想等了。时机永远都不会完美。

transcript.en_text: And I don't want to waste time when I can be getting real experience under my belt.
transcript.zh_text: 我也不想浪费时间，尤其是我可以获得真正的经验的时候。

transcript.en_text: So set a date, hold a press conference, and let's do it.
transcript.zh_text: 所以定个日期，召开新闻发布会，然后就这么办吧。

transcript.en_text: Claire!
transcript.zh_text: 克莱尔！

transcript.en_text: I was not trying to suggest that you not be the ambassador - when I brought up Cathy. I was just-- - We made a deal, and now you're trying to back away from it.
transcript.zh_text: 我提凯茜的时候，并不是想建议你不要当大使。我只是——我们达成了协议，而你现在却想反悔。

transcript.en_text: - That is not true. - Then you would've told Cathy it's happening to make her peace with that.
transcript.zh_text: - 那不是真的。 - 那你就会告诉凯茜事情已成定局，让她接受事实。

transcript.en_text: - It's not that simple. - Yes, it is.
transcript.zh_text: “- 没那么简单。- 不，就是。”

transcript.en_text: - You're the president. - I can't control Congress.
transcript.zh_text: “- 你是总统。- 我控制不了国会。”

transcript.en_text: I'm trying to get two major initiatives off the ground and every move I make will have an effect.
transcript.zh_text: “我正努力让两项重大议案步入正轨，我走的每一步都会产生影响。”

transcript.en_text: We agreed to this before we ever stepped foot in this house.
transcript.zh_text: “我们还没踏进这房子之前就达成了一致。”

transcript.en_text: - I know what we agreed to. - How am I supposed to run for office at some point if I don't have a legitimate track record?
transcript.zh_text: “- 我知道我们同意什么了。- 如果我没有合法的政绩，我以后怎么参选呢？”

transcript.en_text: We have to survive the next 18 months, accomplish something, and then look ahead.
transcript.zh_text: “我们必须熬过接下来的18个月，做出点成绩，然后展望未来。”

transcript.en_text: Francis, let's be realistic.
transcript.zh_text: “弗朗西斯，我们现实点吧。”

transcript.en_text: There's no guarantee you'll get elected.
transcript.zh_text: “你没法保证能当选。”

transcript.en_text: I need to be prepared if you don't.
transcript.zh_text: “如果你不当选，我需要做好准备。”

transcript.en_text: You have that much faith in me, do you?
transcript.zh_text: “你对我这么有信心，是吗？”

transcript.en_text: More faith than you have in me, it seems.
transcript.zh_text: “看来比你对我的信心还多。”

transcript.en_text: I believe in you more than anyone, Claire.
transcript.zh_text: “克莱尔，我比任何人都更相信你。”

transcript.en_text: Then show it. Nominate me. I shouldn't have to convince you.
transcript.zh_text: “那就表现出来。提名我。我本不该说服你。”

transcript.en_text: It's not about convincing.
transcript.zh_text: “这不是说服的问题。”

transcript.en_text: It's about being honest about the political climate - that we find ourselves-- - I'm almost 50 years old.
transcript.zh_text: “这关乎对我们所处的政治气候坦诚相待——我快50岁了。”

transcript.en_text: I've been in the passenger seat for decades.
transcript.zh_text: “我当了几十年副驾驶了。”

transcript.en_text: It's time for me to get behind the wheel.
transcript.zh_text: “是时候我来掌舵了。”

transcript.en_text: That needs to start now. Before the election.
transcript.zh_text: “现在就得开始。在大选之前。”

transcript.en_text: Because who knows what will happen? What if you lose?
transcript.zh_text: “因为谁知道会发生什么？万一你输了呢？”

transcript.en_text: I will not be a placeholder president, Claire.
transcript.zh_text: “克莱尔，我不会成为一个有名无实的总统。”

transcript.en_text: I will win. And I will leave a legacy.
transcript.zh_text: 我会赢。我会留下宝贵的遗产。

transcript.en_text: You mean we will.
transcript.zh_text: 你是说我们会赢。

transcript.en_text: Excuse me, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 抱歉，先生。

transcript.en_text: The Secretary of Defense is on the line. He says it's urgent.
transcript.zh_text: 国防部长在电话线上。他说事情很紧急。

transcript.en_text: Yes?
transcript.zh_text: 什么事？

transcript.en_text: Okay.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。

transcript.en_text: I'm coming.
transcript.zh_text: 我来了。

transcript.en_text: Not until I get there.
transcript.zh_text: 等我到了再说。

transcript.en_text: - I'll be right down. - Yes, sir.
transcript.zh_text: - 我马上就下来。 - 是的，先生。

transcript.en_text: Get dressed. I want you to see something.
transcript.zh_text: 穿好衣服。我想让你看样东西。

transcript.en_text: Come in.
transcript.zh_text: 请进。

transcript.en_text: - Here. - Thank you.
transcript.zh_text: - 给你。 - 谢谢你。

transcript.en_text: Okay, great.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，很好。

transcript.en_text: Get undressed.
transcript.zh_text: 脱掉衣服。

transcript.en_text: How did this happen?
transcript.zh_text: 这是怎么发生的？

transcript.en_text: Doesn't matter.
transcript.zh_text: 没关系。

transcript.en_text: Let me help you.
transcript.zh_text: 我来帮你。

transcript.en_text: Sh... I'll... I'll do it.
transcript.zh_text: 嘘……我……我来做。

transcript.en_text: I'll be gentle.
transcript.zh_text: 我会轻一点的。

transcript.en_text: Don't be gentle.
transcript.zh_text: 别轻柔。

transcript.en_text: Like that?
transcript.zh_text: 像那样吗？

transcript.en_text: Yeah.
transcript.zh_text: 是的。

transcript.en_text: - Oh, whoa! What the fuck? - It's bourbon.
transcript.zh_text: - 噢，哇！搞什么鬼？- 是波本威士忌。

transcript.en_text: - I-- - That's all. It's just bourbon.
transcript.zh_text: - 我—— - 就这样。只是波本威士忌。

transcript.en_text: - Take it. - I really don't want to.
transcript.zh_text: - 拿着。- 我真的不想。

transcript.en_text: Nothing's going through the skin.
transcript.zh_text: 什么都不会穿透皮肤的。

transcript.en_text: I just want you to squirt it...
transcript.zh_text: 我只是想让你把它喷出来……

transcript.en_text: into my mouth.
transcript.zh_text: 到我嘴里。

transcript.en_text: Okay? Please.
transcript.zh_text: 好吗？求你了。

transcript.en_text: - Is that our target? - Yes, sir.
transcript.zh_text: - 那是我们的目标吗？- 是的，长官。

transcript.en_text: Mr. President, this is a highly classified operation-- I'm clearing the First Lady for this operation.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生，这是一项高度机密行动——我批准第一夫人参与这项行动。

transcript.en_text: Yes, sir. Forgive me, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，长官。请原谅我，长官。

transcript.en_text: We are armed and ready, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 我们已全副武装，准备就绪，长官。

transcript.en_text: Abdullah is in one of those vehicles. We can't tell which one.
transcript.zh_text: 阿卜杜拉在其中一辆车里。我们无法分辨是哪一辆。

transcript.en_text: If they go in three different directions, we wouldn't know where to strike, and if he makes it back to the mountains, we'll lose our satellite track on him.
transcript.zh_text: 如果他们朝三个不同的方向行驶，我们就不知道该在哪里发动袭击，如果他回到山区，我们就会失去对他的卫星追踪。

highlights.zh_word: 朝三个不同的方向行驶

highlights.en_word: lose our satellite track on him

transcript.en_text: Are those children?
transcript.zh_text: 那些是孩子吗？

transcript.en_text: I can't say definitely, sir, but they could be.
transcript.zh_text: 长官，我不能确定地说，但有可能是。

transcript.en_text: Do we have authorization, sir?
transcript.zh_text: 长官，我们有授权吗？

transcript.en_text: - Proceed. - Proceed with the launch.
transcript.zh_text: - 继续。- 继续发射。

transcript.en_text: And ten seconds.
transcript.zh_text: 还有十秒。

transcript.en_text: And five, four, three...
Target is destroyed, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 目标已摧毁，长官。

transcript.en_text: Thank you, everyone.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢大家。

transcript.en_text: I still want it.
transcript.zh_text: 我仍然想要它。

transcript.en_text: All right.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。

transcript.en_text: All right.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。
